newsitem.title: UK: New sugar freight inquiry cited, fixtures few.
newsitem.headline: New sugar freight inquiry cited, fixtures few.

text.p: Business was more subdued on London's sugar freight market on Tuesday with a mixed bag of quoted origins, shipbrokers said.

Among the day's new orders, Fiji Sugar Marketing quoted for 18,500/19,000 tonnes in bulk from Fiji to London for May 10/20 and E D & F Man for 20/25,000 tonnes from the Philippines to US Gulf/Atlantic for May 1/20.
Cargill was open for 13/15,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Acajutla to US Gulf/Atlantic for prompt dates.
Shipbrokers said Benham fixed 10,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Belize to St John for prompt shipment dates.
Elsewhere, Sri Lanka bought 12,500 tonnes of white sugar in its recent tender with delivery set for the first half of June in Colombo.
